material_consumer_audit.partial_artifact_behavior: P0022 and P0069 each have DIRECTED_READING.json and COMMIT.json with material_ready=true, status=partial, fulfilled=false; the reader records an attempt then release_task(status=pending), so absence of directed_readings row is expected for an incomplete answer.
material_consumer_audit.runner_return_behavior: make_directed_reading_runner.read_one returns the artifact as material regardless of partial status; its aggregate materials list includes every non-empty material mapping.
material_consumer_audit.adaptive_cache_behavior: external_closure decorates each returned material, puts it in read_materials, and writes the read_cache_path envelope; this path is separate from directed_readings commit rows.
material_consumer_audit.formal_paper_materials_behavior: _result_paper_materials walks supplement_results and directed_results and collects materials/papers without filtering on fulfilled or directed_readings row presence.
material_consumer_audit.owner_content_behavior: retrieval_loop.owner_content is a supplement-queue ownership projection; directed-reader material is carried under directed_results/materials and _read_materials, so owner_content absence alone does not mean a directed read was dropped.
material_consumer_audit.downstream_case_behavior: case_read_materials unions prior_readings, _result_paper_materials(level1_tools), _result_paper_materials(level2_tools), _result_paper_materials(chapter_tools), and _read_materials; partial material is eligible at this layer.
material_consumer_audit.downstream_chapter_behavior: _chapter_details builds l2_materials with _result_paper_materials(level2_tools) and merges _read_materials into all_materials; status is not used as a DB-row gate.
material_consumer_audit.conclusion: Partial material is retained and has a formal in-memory/downstream consumer path independent of directed_readings rows; this snapshot cannot yet claim that all ten V22 materials reached the next planner stage because level2_tools is still in progress and its stage input is absent.
